The '''Sith Temple''' at [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] was a series of temples built and rebuilt many times by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] at the site of a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as Acablas on the planet [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. The last temple constructed at Acablas was built during the [[New Sith Wars]] when the [[New Sith|Empire]] regained control of the planet and destroyed the [[Jedi Temple (Auratera)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] there.

==History==
Built and rebuilt over the millennia, the Sith Temple of Auratera was built on the lip of [[Aca's Funnel/Legends|Aca's Funnel]] at the Acablas vergence. Constructed on the site of several ancient temples, the Empire's structure was a series of old and new architecture that formed a winding and labyrinthine interior maze. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the pyramid was occupied before the war's end and the victory over the Empire by the Jedi.<ref name="NoP" />

==Layout==
Built on the ruins of older temples, the Sith Pyramid's entrance was located on the rim of the Funnel, with a ceremonial path lined with statues leading deep into the structure. Halfway up the pyramid, a cantilevered balcony reached out over the Funnel, and ended over the cenote opening. It was on this balcony the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemists]] preformed arcane rituals and sacrificed beings to the dark side. In the aftermath of the Sith's loss of control over the pyramid, the ruins were marked by external attack and an internal explosion which left the facility open to the elements.<ref name="NoP" />
